attr.title: Gunslugs (experimental APK adaptation)
attr.desc: Experimental Java/libGDX adaptation of owner-supplied Gunslugs Android data for AArch64 Linux handhelds. Device gameplay validation is pending.
attr.inst: Prepare your own compatible APK on a PC using this project's build/preparation tools. On muOS copy gunslugs into /ports and Gunslugs.sh into /roms/PORTS on the SD card. On ArkOS/dArkOS place both together in the ports folder. Current PortMaster, Westonpack and Java 17 runtimes are required. No original game content is distributed.
